en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's get our bodies moving
Let's clean up a little
I'm tired...

Huh? Like, some kinda workout contest or
something?

Atua says you should workout at night, not
during the day.

I can't disobey Atua.
Not even at your request.
What? You don't hafta do that.
Cuz Atua says so, okay?

He also said that if you really wanna do it,
you should do it alone.

But if you do that, I'll get bored.
So maybe you shouldn't do it after all.

What a funny thing to say, Shuichi.
We haven't done anything yet.

If you're really tired, then how 'bout
I perk you up!?

It's fine, it's fine. With my help, your fatigue
will just melt away!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
